item.title: ABOVE THE RIM: Recap of the 2025-26 TAPPS Basketball State Championships
item.description: State titles have been claimed and All-Tournament teams announced — here’s a look at the weekend’s action....TAPPS 6A BOYS -- Parish overpowers TMI Episcopal to secure 2nd crown in 3 yearsIn its third consecutive trip to the TAPPS 6A State Final, Parish Episcopal delivered a composed, commanding performance, pulling away from TMI Episcopal for a 62-48 victory Saturday in Waco. The triumph marked a second title in three seasons for head coach Ahmad Ajami, as the Panthers capped the winter at 21-7
